Parse PDF, Office files, images, and scanned"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" documents with offline OCR. | DeepSeek Harness 全本地文档智能插件，支持 PDF、Office、图片与离线 OCR"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-docs"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"中文 | Installation prompt"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**dsh-docs** gives your DeepSeek Harness agent real document intelligence —
entirely on your own mac"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"hine. Hand it a PDF, Word, Excel, or PowerPoint file
and get back clean Markdown, plain text, or str"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"uctured JSON; hand it a scanned
page or image and a fully offline OCR pipeline reads it for you. No "},{"id":"p4s4","text":"Docker, no
HTTP service, no API keys, and no document ever leaves your disk."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"It ships a pinned, self-contained Python + Xberg
runtime with offline Tesseract language data (Engli"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"sh and Simplified Chinese),
delivering complete PDF/Office/OCR coverage on Windows x64 out of the bo"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"x. The
native Xberg Node binding serves as a lightweight non-OCR fallback on any
platform, and every"},{"id":"p5s4","text":" file read stays confined to folders you explicitly
authorize."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The published package and plugin id use the `dsh-doc` spelling and the tools
use `dshdoc_*`; they we"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"re renamed from the initial `dsh-docling` / `docling_*`
release."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## One-prompt install"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"No local checkout or build toolchain is needed. Paste the following prompt into
a running DSH sessio"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"n (for example `dsh web`) in your own project folder. The
Harness agent installs the published npm p"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ackage, downloads the pinned offline
OCR runtime, and configures the plugin in one go. The only prer"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"equisite is a
working `dsh` CLI on Node `^22.19` or `>= 24`; every runtime step is plain
Node.js, so"},{"id":"p8s5","text":" any shell works: cmd, PowerShell, pwsh, or Git Bash."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"After the agent finishes and you restart `dsh web`, check the engine with

`dshdoc_extract`. INSTALL.md documents the same flow plus the
m"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"anual procedure step by step."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Supported and tested inputs"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, Markdown, HTML, CSV, and text
- PNG, JPEG, TIFF, WebP, and scanned PDFs thr"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ough local OCR
- Markdown, plain text, or JSON-shaped Tool Results"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The integration suite generates binary documents outside the repository and
verifies PDF, DOCX, XLSX"},{"id":"p13s2","text":", PPTX, PNG OCR, and scanned-PDF OCR. Test any other
Xberg-supported input against your own corpus b"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"efore enabling it in production."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Quick start with `dsh web`"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Install the published package into the `web` profile:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Windows x64 — fetch the prebuilt offline OCR runtime into a stable directory

YAML below. On other pla"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"tforms, skip the runtime and use `engine: node` with
`defaultOcr: false`."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Add the plugin entry to the web profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The session workspace is readable without further configuration. Add

beyond the workspace, and set `allowWorkspaceFiles: fa"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"lse` only for
allowlist-only lockdown deployments."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Restart `dsh web`, then ask it to read a local document:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Only paths below the session workspace or `allowedLocalRoots` are readable.
Relative paths resolve a"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"gainst the DSH session workspace, not the directory
from which `dsh web` was started."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Offline embedded Python runtime (Windows x64)"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Most users fetch the prebuilt, hash-pinned runtime from the GitHub Release:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"To audit and rebuild from source instead, run:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Either command creates a gitignored `.dsh-runtime/runtime-win32-x64` directory
containing CPython 3."},{"id":"p31s2","text":"11.9, `xberg==1.0.14`, and pinned `eng` / `chi_sim`
Tesseract data. Every downloaded file is SHA-256"},{"id":"p31s3","text":" validated; the artifact
contains a manifest, NOTICE, and SPDX inventory. It does not alter a global"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"
Python installation. Run `node ./scripts/verify-runtime-win32-x64.mjs` before
pointing a profile at"},{"id":"p31s5","text":" a copied runtime artifact."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Point the plugin at the runtime:"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"The Python worker receives only a byte snapshot, display name, MIME type, and
conversion options ove"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"r stdio. It never receives a user path or URL. It runs
offline, refuses missing OCR language packs, "},{"id":"p34s3","text":"and disables document-derived OCR
caching. `dshdoc_health` reports the available OCR languages. See "},{"id":"p34s4","text":"[the runtime
guide](docs/runtime-win32-x64.md)."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"### Node-only fallback"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"Set `engine: node` only when you need PDF/Office/text parsing without the

`tessdataPath` to a reviewed local directory con"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"taining every requested

instead of downloading a model. The Python runtime above is the supported

| `dshdoc_convert_file` | Parse"},{"id":"p39s2","text":" an allowlisted local file. |
| `dshdoc_extract` | Preferred local-file convenience tool. |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"## Security model"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"- Paths are realpathed and checked against every configured root and, unless
`allowWorkspaceFiles` i"},{"id":"p41s2","text":"s disabled, the session workspace. Traversal,
symlink escapes, filesystem roots, non-files, and over"},{"id":"p41s3","text":"sized inputs fail.
- The authorized descriptor is read once into a snapshot before parsing, so a
lat"},{"id":"p41s4","text":"er path replacement cannot change the parsed bytes.
- The Node and Python engines accept bytes only."},{"id":"p41s5","text":" The plugin creates no listener,
URL fetcher, container, or external parser service.
- OCR is Tesser"},{"id":"p41s6","text":"act-only in this release. All requested language packs are read
from the configured local artifact; "},{"id":"p41s7","text":"missing packs fail closed rather than
triggering a model download.
- The descriptor opened for parsi"},{"id":"p41s8","text":"ng must have the same device/inode identity as
the post-open allowlisted path, blocking file replace"},{"id":"p41s9","text":"ment between authorization
and the byte snapshot.
- Results are bounded before becoming Tool Results"},{"id":"p41s10","text":". JSON is limited using the
same pretty representation shown to the model."}],"truncated":true}
